mainText:
Good morning. Weather in Prishtina: 1 degrees now, broken clouds. Next 24 hours: high 4, low -4.

Kosovo foreign investment over 1 billion euros was announced by Minister Mimoza Kusari-Lila at the 11th Investment Management Exhibition in Frankfurt. The milestone marks the first time overseas capital in Kosovo has surpassed the billion-euro threshold.

The United States, China and Russia are intensifying a scramble for Africa's mineral resources, targeting cobalt in the Democratic Republic of Congo, lithium in Mali and uranium in Niger.

A dispute has emerged between the European Union and the United States over the sequencing of steps in peace negotiations aimed at ending Russia's war in Ukraine.

Nvidia's market capitalization jumped by nearly one trillion dollars after founder Jensen Huang returned as chief executive, sending the stock sharply higher.

The documentary "You Can See Everything," chronicling Elizabeth Holmes' fraud case, has earned more than 88 million euros worldwide, setting a new box-office record in the United Kingdom.
